{{Image}}
{{Top|leg}}
A '''survival pack''' was a small sack of emergency supplies. Prisoners en route to the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] colony of [[Ronika/Legends|Ronika]] were given these before landing on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. These packs often included [[allergy paste]]s, [[anti-venom ampule]]s, [[emergency scab bandage]]s and [[ultraviolet eye shield]]s.
